business_problem: The Division of Customer Service under the Department of Vehicle Regulation in KYTC is the sole point of contact for all incoming customers with questions and issues to resolve.
solution_summary: The agency serves 4.1 million drivers in Kentucky, providing customer service for vehicle licensing and taxes. KYTC's previous solution had downtime during peak call times and required expensive third-party assistance. The agency now provides new chatbot features using Connect Customer and improved customer call experience using Connect Customer Wisdom and Connect Customer Cases. KYTC has reduced employee training time by 2 weeks, reduced customer hold and wait times, and improved customer experience by adding several new features to its contact center solution. The Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (KYTC) needed to modernize its contact center solution to better serve the 4.1 million drivers in Kentucky.

solution_components.name: Amazon Connect
solution_components.role: Handles omnichannel interactions for the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Connect Wisdom
solution_components.role: Surfaces recommendations to agents inside the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Connect Cases
solution_components.role: Manages case records generated by the customer and agent support workflows.

business_outcome: KYTC plans to continue innovating its contact center solution using AWS and features of Connect Customer. The agency is working alongside the AWS team to discover new and current features that fit its use case and enhance its contact center service for its customers.
